statement: A `?`-positional glob (`????-??-??-<qslug>.md`) is WRONG: `?` matches ANY character, so it can mistake a LEGACY undated filename for a dated one when the legacy chosen-derived slug happens to be 'date-shaped' in its first 11 characters.
reason: 'skip-qa-22-' positionally satisfies '????-??-??-' (4 chars, dash, 2 chars, dash, 2 chars, dash) without being a date -- it is a legacy filename slugged from the chosen text 'Skip QA pass 22'. Only a digit-CLASS-anchored glob (`[0-9]` character classes, not `?`) correctly rejects this. The conformant result is a brand-new dated file, not the legacy one.
